description: Find which US employers sponsor the most green cards (PERM labor certifications) for a given job title (optionally in a specific city) — a candidate-sourcing / target-account signal for recruiting. Answers 'which companies sponsor the most data engineers for green cards' or 'top PERM sponsors for nurses'. Returns employers ranked by certified PERM filings for the role, each with their filing count and median offered wage. Backed by real DOL PERM disclosures.

city.description: Optional worksite city to scope to, e.g. "AUSTIN" or "NEW YORK".

job_title.description: Job title to rank sponsors for, e.g. "data engineer", "physical therapist".

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2025). Defaults to the most recent full year.

name: perm_top_sponsors
title: Perm Top Sponsors
